name: chartroom-agent
description: Chartroom's agent runtime (Python: FastAPI + LangGraph). Wrapped as a workspace so Turborepo can schedule its gate alongside the TypeScript ones.

scripts.verify: test -x .venv/bin/python || { echo '.venv missing — run: npm run setup:agent'; exit 1; }; .venv/bin/ruff check src tests && .venv/bin/mypy src && .venv/bin/pytest -q
